snippet.title: Repterra is Out Now | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Repterra launches today on Steam. A base-building survival RTS where humanity fights to reclaim a world overrun by prehistoric predators.

Build sprawling colonies. Survive massive dino hordes. Tame, breed, and ride dinosaurs into battle. Three unique factions. Deep strategy. 100,000+ dinosaurs on screen at once.

The world wants you gone. Prove it wrong.
Play now → https://store.steampowered.com/app/2768380/Repterra/
#Repterra #MicroProse #RTS #IndieGame #SurvivalRTS
